589d79e40a45.title: Judge Lets Hacker Behind Massive GTA 6 Leak of 2022 Go Free With a Warning: 'Don't Let This Happen Again'
589d79e40a45.summary: The hacker behind the massive GTA 6 leak in September 2022 has been released on license with a strong warning from the judge.
589d79e40a45.content: The hacker behind the massive GTA 6 leak in September 2022 has been released on license with a strong warning from the judge. Having already served the majority of his seven year sentence, Arion Kurtaj, from Oxford in the United Kingdom, was allowed to go free, conditionally. According to the BBC , the judge warned Kurtaj: "Don't let this happen again." Kurtaj attempted to extort GTA 6 developer Rockstar Games in 2022. After socially engineering his way into the company Slack, the now 21-year-old threatened to release clips of the unfinished game unless Rockstar paid a ransom. He pleaded guilty to the hacking offenses , which he carried out when he was 16 and 17 years old, earlier this week. ⚖️ Arion Kurtaj, 21, has been convicted today for targeting major international companies, hacking into their private systems, stealing information and data, and causing millions of dollars in losses. 📰 https://t.co/UvJTCFWnct https://t.co/3CoLIw7dDs — Crown Prosecution Service (@CPSUK) November 16, 2026 Originally, Kurtaj was sentenced to an indefinite stay in a prison hospital due to his autism diagnosis. After reconsideration, he was deemed fit to stand trial and spent the remainder of his time in a traditional prison, starting in January. With his release, Kurtaj has been given a Serious Crime Prevention Order, which restricts his interactions online, barring him from using social apps like Telegram and Discord, in an attempt to prevent him working with hacker groups. The order will last for five years. The hack happened while Kurtaj was already under police protection in a Travelodge with his computer confiscated. During his stay, he used an Amazon Fire Stick and the hotel television to hack Rockstar, Revolut, and Uber. The GTA 6 hack saw him steal 90 clips of an unfinished build well before Rockstar was ready to show gameplay from its anticipated open-world sequel, which launched last week. It resulted in the first major GTA 6 leak, as early gameplay footage was shared online. Here, we saw dual protagonists Jason and Lucia for the first time. These clips were shared under the online name TeaPotUberHacker. It would be over a year before Rockstar finally showed the protagonists itself, and even longer until we got an official gameplay reveal, which was only shared in August of this year. "If Rockstar does not contact me on Telegram within 24 hours I will start releasing the source code," he said in the company Slack. When the company didn’t respond, he released the files, costing the company $5 million in damages. Just getting started in GTA 6 or wondering what to do next? d19339025ff8.title: GTA 6’s Best-Kept Secret Is the Key to Its Whole Design
d19339025ff8.summary: Rockstar kept a reveal in GTA 6's prologue a secret for years, but now we all know it, it's clear how it guides the game's entire design.
d19339025ff8.content: Warning: this story contains spoilers for GTA 6’s prologue and Chapter 1. In the final months of trailers, screenshots, and extended looks leading up to Grand Theft Auto 6 ’s launch, Rockstar was keeping a huge secret. It had revealed Jason and Lucia to the world years before and, by the summer of this year, we knew that their romantic relationship was core to the story. But until the moment the game went live, we had no idea that the pair were parents. As we all found out in the prologue, Jason and Lucia have a son, Tomás. And more than just a baby, this little infant is the key to GTA 6’s entire design ethos. Historically, Rockstar has drawn from classic crime movie tropes to establish the themes of its stories. Tommy Vercetti cut through all in his path on his way to becoming Miami’s premier crime lord. Carl Johnson rallied the boys in the hood on his quest for revenge. And Niko Bellic put his war-honed killing skills to work on the streets of Liberty City. While there are elements of relatability in all these stories – hurt over dead mothers, discovering the lie of the American dream – you’d be in the tiny minority of players if you could claim to truly recognise the lives of GTA’s protagonists as reflections of your own timeline. But things are different this time. As Lucia orders another free water at her local cafe, her RydeMe app notifies her that her driver account has been suspended. With the cost of living rising and the job market increasingly unstable in the real world, Lucia’s reality is just a step away from ours. As a then-single mother with a baby’s life on the line, the thing that pushes her towards serious crime isn’t the lust for power or infinite riches – it’s the simple need for survival. It’s the most relatable and realistic starting point any GTA has delivered. Later in Chapter 1, after being introduced to Mattia and Kat and their extravagant lifestyle, we do see Lucia pine for money in a more classic GTA manner. The lure of the never-ending party is difficult to ignore after nine months behind bars. But the act that put Lucia in jail is key: before holding up the store, she ejects every bullet from her magazine and clears the pistol’s chamber. She has no intention of murder. All she wants is to afford rent and feed her baby. Similarly, Jason is far from the hardened gangster that we’ve historically seen in GTA. While he’s more involved in the criminal scene than Lucia, for him it’s just a job. Staying away from regular employment because of his awkward military history, he finds cash-in-hand wages via Brian’s drug-running operations. While there are sparks every now and again, it’s a low-level job – practically an Amazon driver for a middleman. This helps ground Jason in a more familiar reality; he’s just looking for a simple life, emphasised by GTA 6’s encouraged morning routine of shower, coffee, and a workout. As the innocent emotional stake of the entire piece, Tomás encourages a more realistic depiction of our two protagonists. Tomás is emblematic of all this. As the innocent emotional stake of the entire piece, he encourages a more realistic depiction of our two protagonists. And that increased realism flows into the gameplay systems, mission design, and open-world opportunities. While it would be foolish to suggest that Tomás was the idea that began GTA 6’s pursuit of incredibly detailed realism, he is the character that makes the design feel complete and authentic, despite barely being a part of the story. As such, there is a weird link between a baby and the security systems that make car theft so much more complicated than just tapping a button. Less weird is the link between Tomás and the home improvement missions that have ruffled so many feathers among those who think every GTA game should adhere to a very particular formula. bb20beff33b9.title: GTA 6 Leaker Cyberleek Reportedly Releases .exe File for Xbox Build, Sparking Concern an Unofficial PC Port Could Be Around the Corner
bb20beff33b9.summary: Cyberleek has reportedly made good on their promise and released the executable file for the leaked Xbox build of GTA 6, sparking concern that an unofficial PC port could be around the corner.
bb20beff33b9.content: Cyberleek has reportedly made good on their promise and released the executable file for the leaked Xbox build of GTA 6 , sparking concern that an unofficial PC port could be around the corner. The infamous hacker had vowed to release the .exe for the incomplete GTA 6 Xbox build whether the Cyberleek memecoin hit its market cap target or not , and now it is out in the wild, some within the homebrew scene are preparing to take a close look at it. Cyberleek released the exe with a fresh statement insisting their actions on GTA 6 so far were about “fighting anti-consumerism in the games industry.” Cyberleek also taunts Rockstar parent company Take-Two’s so-far unsuccessful effort to prevent further leaks or, it seems, track down those responsible, saying: “Months of takedowns, subpoenas and wallet tracing later, the hunt is still on and the uploads keep arriving.” They also pushed back on claims the GTA 6 leaks are about little more than pushing a crypto scheme, insisting that crypto was used to generate funds for a secret project outside of the game. “There is no other way to move funds without names,” Cyberleek said, “and this work requires no names.” Some are now predicting that AI-assisted recompilation of the leaked Xbox build could result in GTA 6 on PC in just days, with performance improvements over the console version in weeks. This is of course a nightmare scenario for Take-Two and Sony and Microsoft, which are benefiting greatly from GTA 6 releasing on console only. The console version of GTA 6 targets 30fps across all platforms, although struggles at times to hit that on base PS5, and Xbox Series X and S. As a result, there is huge interest in a potential PC version offering 60fps gameplay. The release of the Xbox build from this month runs counter to the thought that Cyberleek only had access to an early development build of GTA 6, a feeling that was reinforced not only by the videos that were released in the summer, but by the differences that have emerged following the game’s official launch. Fans are calling on people not to spend money on Cyberleek, pointing out the leaker cashed out back in August and did again in October. Analysis of cryptocurrency transactions in late August pointed to the GTA 6 leaker cashing out having earnt around $270,000. IGN had reported on fan skepticism around the alleged leaked gameplay that reportedly showed both Jason and Lucia fully naked . A previous leaked gameplay video allegedly showed a tank spawning into the world, which suggested access to a dev menu of some kind. The leaked videos allegedly showing both Jason and Lucia fully naked also show NPCs failing to react to that in any way, which suggested this effect was achieved with either a dev menu or cheats. In the wake of Cyberleek’s initial leaks, Take-Two issued subpoenas to the likes of Discord as part of its search for the person or group of people responsible. It remains unclear how the gameplay footage, any potential build of the game it was taken from, or this latest Xbox build, escaped the confines of Rockstar's infamous tight security. In August, Rockstar addressed the GTA 6 leaks , describing the situation as "heartbreaking" for its development team and "unfortunate" for fans. At the time, the developer acknowledged that its intended experience for players "may now be impacted by some spoilers," but reiterated GTA 6's previously-confirmed launch date of November 19.

525ba0d2fc75.title: Family-Friendly Fortnite Streamer Goes Viral After Picking Up GTA 6 And Performing the Ultimate Heelturn, Including a Bloody Zoo Rampage
525ba0d2fc75.summary: Nice-guy Fortnite streamer Nick Eh 30 has gone viral after trying GTA 6 — and immediately pushing the violence in Rockstar's game to its limit.
525ba0d2fc75.content: Nice-guy Fortnite streamer Nick Eh 30 has gone viral after trying GTA 6 — and immediately pushing the violence in Rockstar's game to its limit. For almost a decade, cheery Canadian streamer Nicholas " Nick Eh 30 " Amyoony has amassed a community of millions around his family-friendly Fortnite streams. His personal brand is based on pushing positivity, he's known for never swearing on camera, and he's become one of the few Twitch stars partnered with Epic Games to get a skin of himself made available in-game. So it has, understandably, come as something of a surprise to see wholesome Nick Eh 30 embracing the most dastardly deeds GTA 6 has on offer: kicking pet dogs to death in the street , shooting animals in the zoo , and walking down the length of a train executing every passenger at point blank range . As someone who has followed Nick Eh 30 for a while, seeing him wandering around GTA 6's world eliminating swathes of its animal population while chuckling to himself is indeed odd to see. Social media is awash with similar reactions, with posts from his followers stating things like: "IN WHAT UNIVERSE DO YOU NEED TO BE DOING THIS" and "Years of building ramps in Fortnite could not prepare chat for this." But this is all clearly intentional, down to his streams being labelled as humorously promising "family friendly GTA" gameplay (I'm not sure there's any such thing). And the fact this has led people to actually discuss his streams and share clips further has only proven why he's likely doing this. NickEh30 takes a taser to the Zoo in GTA VI https://t.co/4SAVgUCjYm — yoxic (@yoxics) November 22, 2026 All of that said, it's still a surprise to see Nick squarely aiming for the game's brutal "Irredeemable" criminal profile rating — a label that Rockstar has actually made quite difficult to achieve unless you really, really want to play the game as bloodily as possible. It's this, seemingly, which has led to clips of Nick playing fetch with dogs using lumps of C4 , and throwing random NPCs from buildings . Just getting started in GTA 6 or wondering what to do next? e62602da3146.title: The Definitive Proof That GTA 6 and Red Dead Redemption Share The Same Universe
e62602da3146.summary: Here are the seven easter eggs in GTA 6 that prove Red Dead Redemption and Grand Theft Auto take place in the same universe.
e62602da3146.content: From action movies to popular memes, there are dozens and dozens of Easter eggs and references to wider pop culture in GTA 6. But Rockstar has also slipped in more than a few nods to some of the studio’s previous games within Leonida. There’s a Manhunt-themed tattoo, for example, and a ludicrously convoluted secret that has already been unearthed involving a portal back to the days of Vice City. But one series is showing up more than others: Red Dead Redemption. We’re still working our way through finding all of them, as is the rest of the internet, but so far we’ve found seven secrets that relate to the developer’s beloved Western games. From hats and guns to road names and license plates, here are seven Red Dead Easter eggs in GTA 6. Valentine Drive If you’re looking for hidden details about Red Dead, the Western-themed Frontier Mini Golf course is a natural place to start. While none of the holes directly tell the tale of Red Dead Revolver, Red Dead Redemption, or its prequel—aside from squinting at hole four and seeing a snowy train wreck as a tangential nod to RDR2’s prologue—there are still things to find. We’ll get on to who can be seen roaming it in a moment, but before you even set foot inside, an Easter egg can be found. That’s because the attraction itself is located on Valentine Drive, a reference to the first major town you explore in Chapter 1 of Red Dead Redemption 2’s story. This is the location where Arthur famously drinks a few too many beers, has a bit of a dance, and looks for his friend, Lenny. Sadly, alcohol doesn’t seem to be served at this Mini Golf, although there’s nothing stopping you from bringing your own six-pack in. Tiny Arthur Morgan Once you’re on the course, though, a little friend with a familiar face riding on his back may well walk up to you. A small chihuahua with a cowboy toy, dressed in remarkably similar clothing to what Red Dead Redemption 2 protagonist Arthur Morgan wore in many of the game’s trailers. Feel free to give the little guy a pet, too, and his gun-toting rider will look like he’s giving it a little “yeehaw”. Adorable. Arthur’s Hat Perhaps more life-sized Arthur Morgan Easter eggs are more your thing, though. Well, get yourself over to Port Gellhorn to get your hands on, and head in, one such thing. Follow the trail of signs and balloons to find a resident looking to get rid of any old tat. Hidden amongst it all, though, is a real treasure. No, not the cow-patterned Hawaiian shirt, but something that will make fans of Red Dead Redemption 2’s hearts flutter a little: a genuine cowboy hat. Not just any cowboy, either, but Arthur himself. The dark brown colour, complete with twisted rope around the rim, is unmistakable, and is now Jason or Lucia’s to wear whenever they like. An absolute bargain at $35, too. Duke Arms As if we needed any further proof that the Grand Theft Auto and Red Dead Redemption stories take place in the same universe, the Duke Arms Company cements this. At any of Leonida’s Ammu-Nation stores, you can find weapons made by the same gun company that produced the Duke 1853 Navy Revolver in Red Dead Online. On the packaging found inside GTA 6’s gun stores, you can also spot 1853 written out in Roman numerals (MDCCCLIII) on the boxes. It just can’t be a coincidence. Flaco Hern á ndez and Blackwater “The Cowboy’s Prayer is To Die Young” is a Wild West-set novel of which you can read a few pages in GTA 6. There are a few fun little details hidden within. First, a mention of Blackwater, the port city from Red Dead Redemption and its prequel, where John Marston chooses to build his ranch near to. But there’s also a familiar name to those who chose to fully engage with RDR2’s side activities. Flaco Hernández was an infamous outlaw who you can meet during the 2018 game’s “The Noblest of Men, and a Woman” stranger mission. At the end of that story, you knock on his cabin by Cairn Lake and defeat him in a duel. The book in GTA 6 recounts all of these details, confirming

9259c0358563.title: Should You Trust Halifax in GTA 6?
9259c0358563.summary: Should you trust Halifax in GTA 6's chapter three mission, Dubious Provenance? We have the answer.
9259c0358563.content: Warning: Spoilers for the Dubious Provenance mission in chapter three of GTA 6 follow. GTA 6 is full of choices, big and small. In fact, the whole way you choose to play the game is a choice, whether that be as an ultraviolet psychopath or a more professional class of criminal. Or if you decide that Jason and Lucia are a couple hopelessly head-over-heels in love, or more platonic partners in crime. Some choices, however, are much more binary, with instant effects tied to them. One of the clearest examples of this is presented to you during a chapter three mission called Dubious Provenance. Should you trust Halifax or not? The answer is twofold: the smart decision is to reject his offer, but the much more fun option is to place your faith in him. Let me explain. Dubious Provenance kicks off by driving all the way to the fancy town of Capri, found in the east of Leonida, and home to the sort of houses Jason and Lucia can only dream of living in at this point in their story. Just by the centre of town is an antiques store where you’re tasked with bringing the mysterious statue that has fallen into your possession to be valued. Halifax, a man with a fairly convincing British accent, overhears your conversation with the shop’s owner, Evelyn, and offers you a deal. While she isn’t interested in the statue, he most definitely is, telling you that he will get it valued for you if you hand it over. Now, despite his smart appearance, all is not what it seems with Halifax, and without spoiling it too much, he’s not exactly the antiques expert he claims to be. The smart, and arguably correct, choice from a story perspective is to reject him. But the much more fun and beneficial option (if you’re a collectibles hunter) is to accept. Accepting adds a couple more main missions to the Dubious Provenance story rather than just ending it there and then. You’ll also receive the Crowex Octane “Bobby Ambrose” unique watch in return. This is a missable collectible otherwise. But more importantly, you get two more very fun missions to play through. The first includes a stealthy infiltration and a massive, and I mean, massive revelation about Halifax. The second is one of the best chase sequences in GTA 6, scored hilariously to a great bit of contrapuntal music. For full spoilers and a step-by-step guide, you can check out our walkthrough . If you reject, you won’t get the watch, but you will have a second shot at playing through these missions. Halifax will later contact you and give you the option to phone him if you change your mind, transforming these main missions into optional ones. These must be completed by the end of chapter three , or they’ll disappear forever, though. Ultimately, the choice to accept or reject comes down to whether you want the watch or not. Of course, you can choose to just never contact him again if you’re desperate to progress through the story as quickly as possible, but you will miss out on a great bit of fun as a result. So, should you trust Halifax during Dubious Provenance? I’d say yes; it’s a much more fun road to take if you’re looking to squeeze every bit of enjoyment out of GTA 6. d8fe3705a9c1.title: Real Life Strip Club Says It's Had 'Hundreds of Inquiries' From GTA 6 Fans, as Pornhub Traffic Plummets
d8fe3705a9c1.summary: Strip Clubs are part of the very DNA of GTA 6, and exotic dance chain Spearmint Rhino is making the most of it, hiring a choreographer to recreate the moves of the in-game dancers for its patrons. According to the club, it's in response to a wave of requests from visitors and people sliding into its DMs.
d8fe3705a9c1.content: Strip Clubs are part of the very DNA of GTA 6 , and exotic dance chain Spearmint Rhino is making the most of it, hiring a choreographer to recreate the moves of the in-game dancers for its patrons. According to the club, it's in response to a wave of requests from visitors and people sliding into its DMs. "I’m fascinated with the attention to detail from Rockstar," said the head choreographer, Brooke Wilde. "I spent hours in Jack of Hearts and Delights Cabaret, mastering each performance to bring back to Spearmint, and now obsessed gamers can put down their controllers, get out of the bedroom, and experience their favourite virtual lap dances with the Spearmint Rhino girls in the real world. While the in-game strip clubs are addictive, nothing beats the real thing.” While we can't be sure exactly how many people are reaching out to their local strip joints for IRL GTA-inspired bodily contact, you have to respect the hustle. It's also an interesting counterpoint given GTA 6's impact on another part of the adult entertainment industry, with Mashable reporting that Pornhub saw a 15.5% drop an hour after the game was released on November 19. Spearmint Rhino's relationship with the series actually goes back to 2013 and GTA 5, when Rockstar used a play on the name of the clubs, Vanilla Rhino, and Rockstar has said that developers for GTA 6 visited strip clubs in Miami and Florida (where Spearmint Rhino has one of its venues) for research purposes. In GTA 6, Jason and Lucia can both go to strip clubs either together as a couple or individually, and can opt-in for VIP lap dances. As explained in our GTA 6 sex and romance guide , you can throw money at dancers, and if you throw most of your money at one dancer they will remove some of their clothes. “While gamers across the world immerse themselves in virtual worlds, demand for authentic real-world experiences has never been higher and we’ve had hundreds of inquiries from GTA 6 fans," explained the company president and COO, Kathy Vercher. "Strip clubs are such an iconic feature in the franchise, and Spearmint Rhino is uniquely positioned to create a real-world experience for gamers. Thanks to the dedication of our Chief Choreographer, Brooke, we’ve been able to bring the in-game lap dance experience into our venues worldwide, with such accuracy that gamers are guaranteed to get a mindblowing real-life experience.” Just getting started in GTA 6 or wondering what to do next?
